entities.summary: José Francisco da Rocha Pombo (1857–1933) was a Brazilian journalist, professor, poet, lawyer, and historian. He born in Morretes, the son of Manuel Francisco Pombo and Angélica da Rocha. He studied law at UFRJ and began his career in journalism. An ardent abolitionist and republican, he founded the journal O Povo, in whose pages he ran campaigns for both causes.
